canonicalRequirements.statement: Bind the Owner-ratified GATE24 canonical mandate by its exact SHA-256. The mandate freezes design scope only and confers no execution, START, BUILD, contract, precontract, status-transition, ledger, commit or push authority.
This revision is PRECONTRACT ONLY. It authorizes no START, no BUILD and no lifecycle transition, and confers no execution authority unless and until later canonical authority exists.
Reuse the GATE23 terminal dependency proof COMPLETE_CONFIRMED, bound by exact SHA-256. GATE23 is not re-audited and not reopened by this candidate.

The six mandate deferredToContract items remain deliberately unbound in this revision: dimension thresholds and window selections, the classificationQuality definition, the classificationEvidence schema, the ordered RegimeRecordId tuple and canonicalization rules, the classificationQuality to macro-coverage relationship, and the active horizon session count. Binding them is reserved to the GATE24 R0002 contract succession before BUILD.

The CORE_V1 active horizon sessionCount remains unresolved. Admissible candidates are exactly 5, 21, 63, 126 and 252 from the upstream GATE23 ladder; this revision selects none and may not imply one by code default. Selection is docketed to GATE24_R0002_OWNER_DECISION_ACTIVE_HORIZON as a genuine Owner decision.

GATE21, GATE22 and GATE23 surfaces, research/directional-lab, the status ledger, ACTIVE_GATE, the deferred capability registry and index, and the GEE and Fast Gate core stay unmodified by this candidate.

requiredOutputs.role: Pointer to the exact versioned contract

positiveTests.case: the candidate contract and pointer bytes validate against the canonical contract schema
every requiredInput binds its verified SHA-256 exactly, mandate included

any write outside the three authorized contract paths

any selection or code-default implication of an active horizon sessionCount under this revision

reuseRules: Reuse the GATE23 precontract cohort format and the existing GEE precontract primitives without modification.
Reuse the verified mandate and dependency SHA-256 values; do not reserialize or republish them.
Reuse GATE23 COMPLETE_CONFIRMED as the sole predecessor terminal proof.
invalidationRules: Any drift of a hash-pinned required input blocks this candidate.
Any loss of GATE23 COMPLETE_CONFIRMED blocks this candidate.
Any change of GATE24 away from NOT_STARTED blocks this candidate.
Any GATE21, GATE22 or GATE23 mutation blocks this candidate.
Any binding of an R0002-reserved deferredToContract item into this revision blocks this candidate.
closureConditions: This document is a NON_ACTIVATED CANDIDATE. It is not published at governance/gates/GATE24/contracts/, it is not pointed to by any live CURRENT_CONTRACT and no authority has been consumed for it in the repository.
This candidate is not closure, not confirmation, not START and not BUILD.
A later separately authorized lifecycle may publish an identical contract at the canonical path only under its own Owner authority.
nextGateAuthorizationConditions: No next-Gate authorization is created by this candidate.
